title: 😤 Kunal sorted the shared sheet... the filter view nobody switches on #googlesheets #filterviews
title_alts: 🔍 Kunal needs one sheet two ways... what a filter view actually saves #googlesheets #filterviews
😬 Kunal's sort moved everyone's rows... the sheet habit that stops it #googlesheets #teamwork
description_hook: Sorting a shared Google Sheet changes it for every person in the file. A filter view gives you the same sort without touching anyone else's screen.
setting: one shared team spreadsheet open at two different desks
protagonist_type: office worker maintaining a team tracker

characters.name: Kunal
characters.description: twenty-nine, short black hair, grey half-sleeve shirt, silver watch on the left wrist

claims.claim: four hundred orders spread across twelve columns
claims.basis: round illustrative sheet size, used as the worked example
round illustrative filtered row count for the same example

scenes.narration: Sorting a shared Google Sheet sorts it for everyone watching.
scenes.caption: शेयर की गई गूगल शीट को सॉर्ट करते ही सबका व्यू बदल जाता है
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a wooden desk showing a spreadsheet of customer orders, the rows caught mid-resort with a sort arrow on one column header, warm morning light across the keyboard.

scenes.narration: Kunal tidied the team order sheet early on a Monday morning.
scenes.caption: कुनाल ने सोमवार सुबह टीम की ऑर्डर शीट साफ़ कर दी
scenes.image_brief: An early morning home desk with a laptop showing a long spreadsheet of order rows, a cup of tea and a small notepad beside it, pale sunrise light through half-open blinds.

scenes.narration: An hour later a teammate found her rows completely rearranged.
scenes.caption: एक घंटे बाद साथी को अपनी सारी पंक्तियाँ उलट-पुलट मिलीं
scenes.image_brief: A second laptop in a shared office showing the same order spreadsheet with the rows in a different order, a pink sticky note on the screen bezel, cool overhead light.

scenes.narration: One menu keeps your sort private. Here is where it hides.
scenes.caption: एक मेन्यू आपका सॉर्ट निजी रखता है — वह यहाँ छिपा है
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet on screen with the Data menu pulled open and a list of filter entries inside it, the table behind the menu dimmed, even indoor light.

scenes.narration: A regular filter edits the live sheet for every single viewer.
scenes.caption: आम फ़िल्टर लाइव शीट बदल देता है, हर देखने वाले के लिए
scenes.image_brief: Two identical laptop screens side by side on one table, both showing the same spreadsheet sorted the same way, a single funnel icon above the pair, flat neutral light.

scenes.narration: A filter view saves the same rules under your name alone.
scenes.caption: फ़िल्टर व्यू वही नियम सिर्फ़ आपके नाम से सेव करता है
scenes.image_brief: One spreadsheet with a dark banner strip across the top of the table, the rows filtered down to fewer lines, a small personal name tag at the banner edge, calm daylight.

scenes.narration: Kunal's sheet carries four hundred orders spread across twelve columns.
scenes.caption: कुनाल की शीट में चार सौ ऑर्डर और बारह कॉलम हैं
scenes.image_brief: A large monitor filled with a long order spreadsheet, hundreds of numbered rows running off the bottom edge and twelve labelled columns across the top, cool office light.

scenes.narration: He saves a pending view. Twenty rows. Her screen never moves.
scenes.caption: उसने पेंडिंग व्यू सेव किया। बीस पंक्तियाँ। साथी की स्क्रीन हिली नहीं
scenes.image_brief: Two screens on one desk, the left showing twenty filtered order rows under a banner, the right showing the full untouched order list, both under the same soft window light.

scenes.narration: You need edit access to make one. Viewers cannot save views.
scenes.caption: बनाने के लिए एडिट एक्सेस चाहिए; व्यूअर सेव नहीं कर सकते
scenes.image_brief: A sharing panel over a spreadsheet with the role set to viewer, the filter view menu greyed out behind it, a small padlock beside the role label, steady indoor light.

scenes.narration: A saved view also never stops a colleague sorting the sheet.
scenes.caption: सेव किया व्यू किसी साथी को सॉर्ट करने से रोकता भी नहीं
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet with a saved view banner above the table and a cursor resting on a column header sort arrow, the underlying rows shifting, bright daylight on the screen.

scenes.narration: So the sort was never the real mistake. The tool was.
scenes.caption: तो सॉर्ट करना असली चूक नहीं थी। टूल गलत था।
scenes.image_brief: A tidy desk with a laptop showing a sorted spreadsheet and two paper sticky notes beside the trackpad, one marked filter and one marked filter view, warm lamplight.

scenes.narration: Three people can slice one sheet and keep three different orders.
scenes.caption: तीन लोग एक ही शीट को तीन अलग क्रम में देख सकते हैं
scenes.image_brief: Three laptops arranged around a round table, each showing the same order spreadsheet arranged in a visibly different row order, soft lamplight over all three screens.

scenes.narration: Open Data, pick filter views, then choose create new filter view.
scenes.caption: डेटा मेन्यू खोलें, फ़िल्टर व्यूज़ चुनें, फिर नया व्यू बनाएँ
scenes.image_brief: A spreadsheet screen with the Data menu open and the filter views submenu extended to show a create new entry, the table dimmed behind the menu, cool even light.

title: 🙈 Saloni moved one file into a shared folder... who can read it now #googledrive #sharing
title_alts: 🔐 Saloni's Drive folder rules every file inside... check this one panel #googledrive #permissions
📂 Saloni shared a folder, not a file... the link sharing trap inside #googledrive #linksharing
description_hook: In Google Drive, access flows down from the folder. A file you never shared can go public the moment you drag it somewhere convenient.
setting: a home office managing one project folder in Drive

characters.name: Saloni
characters.description: thirty-four, long hair tied back, olive green kurta, thin gold hoop earrings

claims.claim: Her old link had reached fourteen contractors.
claims.basis: round illustrative recipient count for the worked example

scenes.narration: Drive permissions flow downhill. The folder decides, never the file itself.
scenes.caption: ड्राइव की परमिशन ऊपर से नीचे बहती है। फ़ोल्डर तय करता है, फ़ाइल नहीं
scenes.image_brief: A Drive folder tree on a laptop screen, a folder at the top carrying a people icon with arrows flowing down into the files beneath it, cool blue screen light.

scenes.narration: Saloni shared one project folder with anyone who held the link.
scenes.caption: सलोनी ने एक प्रोजेक्ट फ़ोल्डर लिंक वाले सबके लिए शेयर कर दिया
scenes.image_brief: A Drive sharing dialog over a project folder, the general access row set to anyone with the link and a copied link chip sitting below it, even daylight on the screen.

scenes.narration: Weeks later she dragged a payroll sheet into that same folder.
scenes.caption: कुछ हफ़्ते बाद उसने पेरोल शीट उसी फ़ोल्डर में खींच दी
scenes.image_brief: A file with a spreadsheet icon marked payroll being dragged across a Drive window into a folder row that carries a people icon, plain indoor light.

scenes.narration: That single drag published it. Here is the check that catches it.
scenes.caption: उस एक खिंचाव ने उसे पब्लिक कर दिया। जाँच यह है
scenes.image_brief: A Drive file sharing panel open on a laptop, the general access line reading anyone with the link, a magnifying glass lying on the desk beside it, soft lamplight.

scenes.narration: A file inherits every sharing rule of the folder above it.
scenes.caption: फ़ाइल ऊपर वाले फ़ोल्डर के सारे शेयर नियम अपना लेती है
scenes.image_brief: A layered diagram on screen showing one folder with a people badge and three files below it, each file carrying the same badge, clean pale background, flat light.

scenes.narration: No email goes out, so the change lands completely silently.
scenes.caption: कोई ईमेल नहीं जाता, इसलिए यह बदलाव चुपचाप हो जाता है
scenes.image_brief: A phone lying beside a laptop with an empty inbox and no notifications on its screen, the Drive folder open on the laptop behind it, quiet evening light.

scenes.narration: Her old link had reached fourteen contractors. All fourteen could read it.
scenes.caption: उसका पुराना लिंक चौदह कॉन्ट्रैक्टर तक पहुँचा था। सब पढ़ सकते थे
scenes.image_brief: A long table holding fourteen open laptops, each screen showing the same payroll spreadsheet, cold fluorescent office light overhead and empty chairs pushed in.

scenes.narration: The file's sharing panel now says anyone with the link, not her.
scenes.caption: अब फ़ाइल के शेयर पैनल में लिखा है: लिंक वाला कोई भी
scenes.image_brief: A Drive file details sidebar listing the file name, the owner, and a general access row reading anyone with the link, neutral screen light in a dim room.

scenes.narration: Shortcuts are the exception. They point outward and carry no access.
scenes.caption: शॉर्टकट अपवाद हैं। वे बाहर इशारा करते हैं, एक्सेस नहीं देते
scenes.image_brief: A Drive shortcut file with a small arrow badge on its icon, a line running across to a locked original file that carries a padlock, dim desk light.

scenes.narration: Shared drive files follow the drive's members, not the parent folder.
scenes.caption: शेयर्ड ड्राइव की फ़ाइलें उसके मेंबरों से चलती हैं, पैरेंट फ़ोल्डर से नहीं
scenes.image_brief: A shared drive listing in Drive with a members panel open showing role labels beside names, a parent folder greyed out at one side, cool office light.

scenes.narration: So the danger was never the file. It was where it moved.
scenes.caption: तो ख़तरा फ़ाइल नहीं थी। ख़तरा यह था कि वह कहाँ गई
scenes.image_brief: An open Drive folder icon with a warning triangle resting on it and a sensitive looking file hovering just above the folder mouth, dark desk, one desk lamp.

scenes.narration: Before moving anything sensitive, open the destination folder and read its share list.
scenes.caption: कुछ भी संवेदनशील ले जाने से पहले मंज़िल फ़ोल्डर की शेयर लिस्ट पढ़ें
scenes.image_brief: A Drive window with the destination folder sharing panel open and its access list fully visible, the file still sitting outside the folder, calm daylight.

title: 📦 Mohit deleted a thousand emails... the search that frees real space #gmail #storage
title_alts: 🔎 Mohit wants the heavy mail only... one Gmail search by attachment size #gmail #searchoperators
😤 Mohit's storage bar refuses to drop... the bin step everyone skips #gmail #storage
description_hook: A full Gmail is almost never caused by the number of emails. Eleven attachments can outweigh a thousand newsletters.
setting: a cramped evening desk with a nearly full storage meter on screen
protagonist_type: student running out of free account space

characters.name: Mohit
characters.description: twenty-two, curly hair, navy hooded sweatshirt, thick black-framed glasses

claims.basis: round illustrative count of small emails, used as the worked example
illustrative search threshold chosen for the example, not a fixed rule
round illustrative sizes that make the contrast concrete

claims.claim: Those thousand newsletters held only forty megabytes
claims.basis: round illustrative figure paired with the example above

scenes.narration: Gmail storage ignores how many emails you keep.
scenes.caption: जीमेल का स्टोरेज इससे नहीं चलता कि आपने कितने ईमेल रखे हैं
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a dark table showing a Gmail storage meter almost entirely filled, the red section of the bar dominating the screen, dim evening light in the room.

scenes.narration: Mohit deleted a thousand newsletters one evening and freed almost nothing at all.
scenes.caption: मोहित ने एक शाम हज़ार न्यूज़लेटर हटाए, फिर भी जगह नहीं बनी
scenes.image_brief: A laptop showing a Gmail inbox with hundreds of newsletter rows selected in blue and a bin icon above the list, late evening light from a single desk lamp.

scenes.narration: The storage bar stayed stubbornly full, and then new mail stopped arriving.
scenes.caption: स्टोरेज बार भरा ही रहा, और फिर नए मेल आना बंद हो गए
scenes.image_brief: A Gmail account storage page on a laptop with the usage bar still nearly full and a warning strip above it, a cold blue glow filling the dark room.

scenes.narration: Size decides, not count. One search shows you exactly where the weight is sitting.
scenes.caption: आकार मायने रखता है, गिनती नहीं। एक सर्च वज़न दिखा देती है
scenes.image_brief: A kitchen weighing scale on a desk beside a laptop, one thick padded envelope tipping the pan while a heap of thin letters sits untouched, warm light.

scenes.narration: Gmail can filter mail by attachment size, so the heavy few surface right away.
scenes.caption: जीमेल अटैचमेंट के आकार से मेल छान सकता है, भारी मेल पहले आते हैं
scenes.image_brief: A Gmail search bar on screen with a size filter panel open beneath it and the result list reordered so the biggest messages stand at the very top, clean daylight.

scenes.narration: His search asked only for messages carrying attachments larger than ten megabytes.
scenes.caption: उसने सिर्फ़ दस मेगाबाइट से बड़े अटैचमेंट वाले मेल खोजे
scenes.image_brief: A Gmail search box on a laptop with a size condition typed inside it, the inbox behind the box faded, the cursor blinking at the end of the query, bright screen light.

scenes.narration: Eleven mails held four gigabytes. Those thousand newsletters held only forty megabytes.
scenes.caption: ग्यारह मेल में चार गीगाबाइट थे। हज़ार न्यूज़लेटर में सिर्फ़ चालीस मेगाबाइट
scenes.image_brief: A Gmail result list of eleven messages, each row carrying a large paperclip and a file size label, a thin stack of newsletters beside the laptop, cool light.

scenes.narration: Deleting is not enough. Binned mail counts until the bin is emptied.
scenes.caption: हटाना काफ़ी नहीं। बिन में पड़ा मेल खाली करने तक गिना जाता है
scenes.image_brief: A Gmail bin folder open on screen, crowded with deleted messages, the storage bar at the top unchanged and still nearly full, grey afternoon light from a window.

scenes.narration: Storage is also shared with Drive and Photos, so check both of those too.
scenes.caption: स्टोरेज ड्राइव और फ़ोटोज़ के साथ बँटा है, दोनों को भी देखिए
scenes.image_brief: Three storage meters drawn side by side on a screen, labelled for mail, drive and photos, all drawing from one shared tank beneath them, flat even light.

scenes.narration: So the crowded inbox was never the real problem. Eleven attachments were.
scenes.caption: तो भरा इनबॉक्स असली समस्या नहीं था। ग्यारह अटैचमेंट थे।
scenes.image_brief: A tidy Gmail inbox on a laptop next to one huge parcel standing upright on the desk, the parcel dwarfing the laptop, warm lamplight from the right.

scenes.narration: Search for attachments over ten megabytes, delete the worst, then empty the bin.
scenes.caption: दस मेगाबाइट से बड़े अटैचमेंट खोजें, सबसे भारी हटाएँ, फिर बिन खाली करें
scenes.image_brief: A Gmail screen with a size search in the bar, eleven heavy results ticked, and an empty bin option visible above the list, calm morning light on the desk.

title: 😨 Prisha's paragraph vanished from a shared doc... undo cannot reach it #googledocs #versionhistory
title_alts: ⏳ Prisha needs an older draft back... what Docs version history keeps #googledocs #versionhistory
😬 Prisha's team pasted over her draft... the Docs habit that saves it #googledocs #collaboration
description_hook: A paragraph missing from a shared Google Doc is not lost, and undo is the wrong place to look for it. Version history holds every edit and its author.
setting: two writers working on one shared brief from different desks
protagonist_type: writer sharing a brief with reviewers

characters.name: Prisha
characters.description: thirty-one, shoulder-length wavy hair, mustard cardigan, small silver nose stud

claims.claim: Someone else had cut it two days earlier
claims.basis: illustrative timing for the worked example

claims.claim: found thirty entries for that week
claims.basis: round illustrative number of saved versions
illustrative spot-check count suggested as an action

scenes.narration: Google Docs records every edit, with the name of each editor.
scenes.caption: गूगल डॉक्स हर बदलाव और हर एडिटर का नाम दर्ज करता रहता है
scenes.image_brief: A laptop showing a shared document with a version history sidebar open on the right, a list of timestamped entries and editor names down the panel, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Prisha opened a shared brief and one whole paragraph was gone.
scenes.caption: प्रिशा ने शेयर किया ब्रीफ़ खोला और एक पूरा पैराग्राफ़ गायब था
scenes.image_brief: A document on screen with an obvious gap between two paragraphs where text is missing, the cursor sitting in the empty line, cool morning light from a window.

scenes.narration: Undo did nothing. Someone else had cut it two days earlier.
scenes.caption: अनडू से कुछ नहीं हुआ। किसी और ने दो दिन पहले काट दिया था
scenes.image_brief: A document on screen with the undo arrow in the toolbar greyed out and a resolved comment marker from an earlier day beside the gap, dim room light.

scenes.narration: The paragraph still exists. Version history is where it waits.
scenes.caption: पैराग्राफ़ अब भी मौजूद है। वह वर्ज़न हिस्ट्री में रखा हुआ है
scenes.image_brief: A version history sidebar over a faded document, one older entry highlighted in the list and a small preview of the older text beside it, warm lamplight.

scenes.narration: Docs saves a timeline of versions instead of one flat file.
scenes.caption: डॉक्स एक फ़ाइल नहीं, वर्ज़न की पूरी टाइमलाइन सेव करता है
scenes.image_brief: A row of paper drafts laid out along a wide desk, each sheet marked with a time and slightly different text, the newest sheet nearest the chair, even light.

scenes.narration: Each version keeps who typed what, so every change has an author.
scenes.caption: हर वर्ज़न बताता है किसने क्या लिखा, हर बदलाव का लेखक होता है
scenes.image_brief: A document paragraph tinted in two different colours with two small name labels in the margin pointing at their own sentences, pale background, flat light.

scenes.narration: Prisha opened version history and found thirty entries for that week.
scenes.caption: प्रिशा ने वर्ज़न हिस्ट्री खोली, उस हफ़्ते की तीस एंट्री मिलीं
scenes.image_brief: A version history panel filled with about thirty timestamped entries grouped under day headings, the document greyed out behind the panel, cool office light.

scenes.narration: An earlier version held her paragraph. She copied the text straight out.
scenes.caption: पिछले वर्ज़न में उसका पैराग्राफ़ था। उसने टेक्स्ट सीधे कॉपी कर लिया
scenes.image_brief: An older document version open on screen with one paragraph highlighted in blue and a copy icon beside it, quiet afternoon light falling on the desk.

scenes.narration: Restoring a whole version overwrites everyone's later work. Copy instead.
scenes.caption: पूरा वर्ज़न रिस्टोर करने से बाद का सारा काम मिट जाता है। कॉपी करें
scenes.image_brief: A document with a restore banner across the top and the newer edits beneath it shown struck through, a warning triangle inside the banner, stark light.

scenes.narration: And a fresh copy of a doc starts with an empty history.
scenes.caption: और डॉक की नई कॉपी खाली हिस्ट्री से शुरू होती है
scenes.image_brief: A duplicated document open beside the original, its version history panel empty except for a single first entry, dim light from one side of the desk.

scenes.narration: So undo is the wrong tool for a shared document entirely.
scenes.caption: तो शेयर किए दस्तावेज़ के लिए अनडू गलत औज़ार ही है
scenes.image_brief: One shared document open on two laptops facing each other across a table, an undo arrow drawn between them with a cross over it, plain daylight.

scenes.narration: The real safety net is a timeline nobody has to switch on.
scenes.caption: असली सुरक्षा जाल वह टाइमलाइन है जिसे चालू करना ही नहीं पड़ता
scenes.image_brief: A long printed timeline strip running across a desk with dots marking saved versions and a woven net lying beneath the strip, warm light from above.

scenes.narration: Open File, choose version history, and read the last three entries.
scenes.caption: फ़ाइल मेन्यू खोलें, वर्ज़न हिस्ट्री चुनें, पिछली तीन एंट्री पढ़ें
scenes.image_brief: A document with the File menu open and the version history entry highlighted inside it, the document text dimmed behind the open menu, cool even light.
